name: Octatrack
summary: Effects, machines, MIDI and USB modules built on octabam.

firmware.flash: Copy the .bin to the card root, then PROJECT › SYSTEM › OS UPGRADE.
firmware.recovery: Hold FUNC while powering on, choose MIDI UPGRADE and send the stock .syx over DIN MIDI.

sdk.toolchain: GNU binutils 2.47 (m68k-elf) and the dsp56300 assembler, run in the pinned build container (sdk/build/Dockerfile).

budgets.name: Reserved module memory
budgets.note: The bottom 1,707 pages (6,144 B each) of the audio page arena that the octabam platform reserves for modules.
